newsitem.title: USA: Kansas gov signs $117 mln tax relief package.
newsitem.headline: Kansas gov signs $117 mln tax relief package.

text.p: Kansas Gov. Bill Graves on Friday signed legislation giving $117 million in tax relief.

The new laws include $60.7 million in property tax relief by reducing the uniform statewide public education levy, $31 million in homestead property tax relief and $16.3 million in reduced income taxes, the governor stated in a news release.

The package also includes $6.8 million in relief by widening the eligibility for homestead property tax rebates and $2 million in incomes tax breaks to Kansas families that adopt children, the release stated.
Graves also signed a bill providing for $36 million in additional funding for the state's public schools.
